scholarships.name: Vocational Rehabilitation Grants
scholarships.description: • These grants are made through the Department of Human Services for students who have some type of disability. Contact the local office of the Department of Human Services for more details.

scholarships.name: Special Note: If a student withdraws prior to the first day of class, a 100% refund will be granted.
scholarships.description: The date used to calculate the student‘s refund or repayment is the effective date reflected on the official College withdrawal form. If a student does not officially withdraw from the College, an effort will be made to determine the last date on which he/she had no intention of returning to class.
